snippet.title: THE GAME OF LIFE 2 | OUT NOW | STEAM
snippet.description:
🖥️ Play The Game of Life 2 on Steam!  

With more choices and more freedom than ever before, there are a thousand new ways to live – and win – in The Game of Life 2. 

With cross-platform gaming, you can challenge friends and family on The Game of Life 2 whether they’re on PC, iPhone or Android! 

Buy the Deluxe Life Collection to get the base game and ten more worlds to explore right away! 

🎮 Available now on PC, mobile and console:
🔹PlayStation: https://bit.ly/gol2-ps
🔹Xbox: https://bit.ly/gol2-xbox
🔹Nintendo Switch: https://bit.ly/gol2-switch
🔹Steam: https://bit.ly/the-game-of-life-2-steam
🔹Apple App Store: https://apple.co/4cB9UAT
🔹Google Play Store: https://bit.ly/gol2-android
